findings.title: One failed cancellation prevents processing every later reminder
findings.body: The `try`/`catch` wraps the entire cancellation loop, so a single SendGrid error exits the loop and leaves all subsequent reminders in `remindersToCancel` untouched. Because the failed reminder remains marked cancelled, it can be retried on every cron run and repeatedly prevent later reminders from being cancelled; those scheduled emails may therefore still be sent. Handle failures per reminder so one bad batch does not block the rest.
